title: Coastal Marsh Adventures

services.name: Afternoon Fishing Charters
services.desc: The best way to spend your afternoon! About Experience the exquisite tidal creeks found in the Lowcountry of North and South Carolina . Enjoy world class fishing in the inshore back creeks, jetties, and near-shore at wrecks and reefs or just sit back and enjoy the relaxing views of what the coastal marsh has to offer. Departures start out at Little River South Carolina on a 24ft Pathfinder that is powered by a 300 HP Yamaha. The vessel is equipped with GPS, a Garmin sonar and VHF onboard radio for safe and efficient navigation. The vessel also utilizes a Power Pole and a Minn Kota trolling Private Charter • Up to 4 people • 3-4 hours

services.name: Offshore Fishing Charters
services.desc: Your own private offshore cruise! 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 13 Hours Prices include first 4 people and additional cost at $100 each additional up to 6 total About The crew will welcome you aboard a 30 ft cuddy cabin that can reach speeds up to 30 knots. The vessel is equipped with GPS, Sonar fishfinder, live well and outriggers. You will be supplied with rods, reels and tackle as well as lures and live bait. In order for us to best prepare and design the offshore experience for you, please call (304) 807-7577 to All Ages • Up to 6 people • 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 13 hours

services.name: Bachelor & Bachelorette Adventure
services.desc: Set Sail from Little River on a Scenic Adventure Experience! About Departing from Little River, you’ll board a 24-foot Pathfinder center console bay boat, designed for comfort and optimal viewing. As you glide through the serene intercoastal waters, you’ll be treated to picturesque views of the marshes and the diverse wildlife that call this area home. Why Choose Coastal Marsh Adventures for Your Unique Adventure? Unforgettable Water View: At any moment you can be witness to beautiful intracoastal setting over the waters of the jetties. Watch as the sky transforms into a canvas of vibrant Private Charter • Up to 6 people • 3 hours
